The '''Ardent Crusade''' occurred by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Covered by a [[Color/Legends|gray]] shell, a cubic relic of the crusade was blue, green, and red in color.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|Relic of the Ardent Crusade}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ardent Crusade was mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the in-game item "Relic of the Ardent Crusade." Labeled a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] relic, the item increased Endurance and Critical damage ratings when equipped.<ref name="TOR" />
